title: plugin-auth: a correct-password sign-in refused by an organization IP list counts toward the account lockout
body:
domain:server#6 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5p3T5YWhLjurajudnQ

Out-of-scope finding (class a) from the #30924 PR 2 dev (report 6712181248 on #30924), filed by `domain:server#6`. ⛔ Not a claim. Suggested-grade: p2 (a person working from outside their organization's network locks their own account with the right password; an administrator then has to unlock it).

**Observed (measured by the #30924 dev on `main`):** an organization with `allowed_ip_ranges`, deployment lockout threshold 3. Three sign-ins with the CORRECT password from outside the organization's list each answer `403 IP_NOT_ALLOWED` (`SESSION_SCOPING_REFUSAL`, refused when the session is created). The fourth sign-in, from INSIDE the list with the correct password, answers `403 ACCOUNT_LOCKED`; `failed_login_count` is 3.

**Cause:** `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager-after-hook.ts` (the ADR-0069 D2 counter, `SIGN_IN_EMAIL_PATH` branch) treats ANY `APIError` on `ctx.context.returned` as a failed credential and calls `recordSignInOutcome(email, false)`. The organization IP refusal is thrown after the password was verified, so it is counted as if the password were wrong.

**Expected:** only a refused CREDENTIAL counts toward lockout. A policy refusal after the credential passed (organization IP list; check whether any other post-credential refusal shares the path) neither increments nor resets the counter. Its audit row stays as #30924 writes it.

**Reach:** public door `POST /api/v1/auth/sign-in/email`. Not a disclosure: a wrong password already counts, so this adds no new way for a stranger to lock an account; it locks out the account holder who did nothing wrong.

**Pins owed:** the measured sequence above, red on `main`, green after; a wrong-password control still counts; a correct sign-in from inside the list still resets.

Dedupe words: lockout IP_NOT_ALLOWED, organization allowed_ip_ranges lockout, recordSignInOutcome scoping refusal.
